last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 7
last_episode_to_air.overview: Hasan's leap from the cliff leaves Emir and his friends in utter desperation. While Sado and Mert pull Emir back from the brink of danger, hope in the neighborhood gradually fades away. Naz is forced to make a difficult decision to keep Emir going. Alina and Duru never leave the young people alone for a moment. Watching the friendship that rallies around Emir, Uzay confronts his conscience and his loneliness. Just as everyone else loses hope, Emir prepares to take action with Rami's support. As the distance between Emir and Melek grows, the closeness between Naz and Emir deepens more and more. The new deal struck by Bayram and Galip lights the fuse for events that will upend all the balances. With Uzay's new move, Emir faces a fresh test, while Naz is shattered by the truth she learns and finds herself in a place she never expected. A visitor who shows up by chance puts Fahriye in a tough spot. The truth that Emir tries to reach on his own draws him into a massive trap.

name: Different Lives
overview: For Emir and his friends—Hasan, Sadık, and Mert—who grew up in Ziyankâr, a working-class neighborhood on the outskirts of Istanbul, life feels like a game they’ve lost before it even began. Trapped between poverty, violence, and despair, these four young men see soccer as their only chance to change their fate. They try to break free from this darkness through their friendship and their dreams.
